findings.detail: Child digital safety agent and School and KHDA regulator agent both acted as lead on 'harmful_content'; no rule in the KB says which one leads.
Child digital safety agent learned of 'harmful_content' 1 stage(s) after it first occurred.
Ministry of Education agent learned of 'harmful_content' 2 stage(s) after it first occurred.
School and KHDA regulator agent learned of 'harmful_content' 1 stage(s) after it first occurred.
Data-protection authority agent has a mandate over 'minor_data' but never received that information.
Child digital safety agent learned of 'minor_data' 1 stage(s) after it first occurred.
School and KHDA regulator agent has a mandate over 'ai_use' but never received that information.
